scripts.android:add: npm run build:native-auth && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/configure-capacitor.mjs && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:native-auth && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/configure-capacitor.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
